story_title: BBVA Scales ChatGPT Enterprise to 100,000 Employees with OpenAI
caption:
100,000 bankers just got ChatGPT Enterprise.

Banking giant BBVA has partnered with OpenAI to scale ChatGPT Enterprise across its entire global workforce of 100,000 employees.

Banking is historically one of the most heavily regulated and risk-averse industries on Earth. Moving from small internal trials to a full-scale 100k deployment signals a massive shift in how enterprise compliance and AI infrastructure are handled.

AI is officially moving from opt-in utility to default corporate infrastructure.
